\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.22}
\begin{lem}[{The series of log(1 - z) and log(1 + z)}]\label{thm:cc-log-one-minus}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-log-one-minus}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{clhr} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 < \mathit{clhr}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad ((\mathit{clhr} \cdot (1 + \pi)) \leq \pi) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{clhz} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(\mathit{clhz}) < \mathit{clhr}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \log\left((1 - \mathit{clhz})\right) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; -\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda \mathit{clhk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({\mathit{clhk}}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}(\mathit{clhz}, \mathit{clhk})))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-log-one-plus}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{algc} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{algc}(0) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{algj} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{algc}((\mathit{algj} + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{power}(-1, \mathit{algj}) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((\mathit{algj} + 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{algr} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 < \mathit{algr}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\mathit{algr} \cdot (1 + \pi)) \leq \pi) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{algz} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(\mathit{algz}) < \mathit{algr}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \log\left((1 + \mathit{algz})\right) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda \mathit{cpsk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{algc}(\mathit{cpsk}) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\mathit{algz}, \mathit{cpsk})))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{log0-is-log-on-ball}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{algc} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{algc}(0) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{algj} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{algc}((\mathit{algj} + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{power}(-1, \mathit{algj}) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((\mathit{algj} + 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{algr} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 < \mathit{algr}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\mathit{algr} \cdot (1 + \pi)) \leq \pi) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{algz} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 1, \mathit{algr}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \log\left(\mathit{algz}\right) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda \mathit{cpsk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{algc}(\mathit{cpsk}) \cdot \operatorname{power}((\mathit{algz} - 1), \mathit{cpsk})))) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%

The full disc |z| $<$ 1 needs log = log0 on all of B(1, 1), i.e. the identity theorem 3.35 or a lemma that a continuous integer-valued function on a connected set is constant, neither of which the tree has.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.1}
\begin{prop}[{Path additivity of the line integral}]\label{thm:line-int-concat}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{line-int-concat}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, \mathit{prho}, \mathit{drho}, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{prho}, \mathit{drho}, c, d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{pgam}(b) = \operatorname{prho}(c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}, a, b) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{prho}, c, d) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{juxta}(\mathit{pgam}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{jxs} \in \operatorname{ccint}(b, (b + (d - c))).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{prho}((c + (\mathit{jxs} - b)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad a, b, (b + (d - c))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{juxta}(\mathit{dgam}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{jxs} \in \operatorname{ccint}(b, (b + (d - c))).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{drho}((c + (\mathit{jxs} - b)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad a, b, (b + (d - c))), \\ \quad \quad \quad a, (b + (d - c))) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) + \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{prho}, \mathit{drho}, c, d)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{line-int-juxta}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{pgam}_{1}, \mathit{dgam}_{1}, \mathit{pgam}_{2}, \mathit{dgam}_{2}, a, b, c. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}_{1}, \mathit{dgam}_{1}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}_{2}, \mathit{dgam}_{2}, b, c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{pgam1}(b) = \operatorname{pgam2}(b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}_{1}, a, b) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}_{2}, b, c) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{juxta}(\mathit{pgam}_{1}, \mathit{pgam}_{2}, a, b, c), \operatorname{juxta}(\mathit{dgam}_{1}, \mathit{dgam}_{2}, a, b, c), a, \\ \quad \quad \quad c) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{pgam}_{1}, \mathit{dgam}_{1}, a, b) + \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{pgam}_{2}, \mathit{dgam}_{2}, b, c)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{juxta-is-road}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{pgam}_{1}, \mathit{dgam}_{1}, \mathit{pgam}_{2}, \mathit{dgam}_{2}, a, b, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}_{1}, \mathit{dgam}_{1}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}_{2}, \mathit{dgam}_{2}, b, c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{pgam1}(b) = \operatorname{pgam2}(b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\operatorname{juxta}(\mathit{pgam}_{1}, \mathit{pgam}_{2}, a, b, c), \operatorname{juxta}(\mathit{dgam}_{1}, \mathit{dgam}_{2}, a, b, c), a, c) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{regulated-on-glue}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (a < c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (c < b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall f_{1}, f_{2}, f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regulated\text{-}on}(f_{1}, a, c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regulated\text{-}on}(f_{2}, c, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad (f \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, c).\; ((t < c) \Rightarrow (f(t) \simeq \operatorname{f1}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, b).\; ((c < t) \Rightarrow (f(t) \simeq \operatorname{f2}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regulated\text{-}on}(f, a, b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{tri-int-is-line-int}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), 0, 1) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(b, c), 0, 1) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(c, a), 0, 1) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, c) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{tri\text{-}road}(a, b, c), \operatorname{tri\text{-}road\text{-}deriv}(a, b, c), 0, 3) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{line-int-length-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}, a, b) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{bnd} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{bny} \in \operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}, a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(\mathit{bny})) \leq \mathit{bnd}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{road\text{-}length}(\mathit{dgam}, a, b) \cdot \mathit{bnd}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{line-int-adjacent}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}, a, b) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{licv} \in \operatorname{ooint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(\mathit{pgam}, \operatorname{ccint}(a, \mathit{licv})), \operatorname{restrict}(\mathit{dgam}, \operatorname{ccint}(a, \mathit{licv})), a, \mathit{licv}) + \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(\mathit{pgam}, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{licv}, b)), \operatorname{restrict}(\mathit{dgam}, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{licv}, b)), \mathit{licv}, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{road-restrict}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b, \mathit{licv}, \mathit{lidv} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (a \leq \mathit{licv}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\mathit{licv} < \mathit{lidv}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\mathit{lidv} \leq b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\operatorname{restrict}(\mathit{pgam}, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{licv}, \mathit{lidv})), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(\mathit{dgam}, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{licv}, \mathit{lidv})), \mathit{licv}, \mathit{lidv}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} PROVEN 2026-09-26 (batch 37): the juxtaposition JUXTA(gamma, rho, a, b, c) of roads on adjacent intervals (Dieudonne 9.6; structure-library/road-juxtaposition.scm) is a road (juxta-is-road, with the new regulated-on-glue) and the integral adds (line-int-juxta); the notes' (49) for gamma on [a, b] and rho on [c, d] with gamma(b) = rho(c) is line-int-concat, rho shifted to [b, b + (d - c)]. Also the triangular road TRI-ROAD on [0, 3] with tri-int-is-line-int, and ROAD-LENGTH (the integral of |gamma'|) with the length estimate (53), line-int-length-bound. Earlier: UPDATED 2026-09-23 (batch 24): the SPLIT form is proven -- line-int-adjacent: for a road gamma on [a, b], c in (a, b) and f continuous on a set containing the trace, the integral along gamma is the sum of the integrals along the restrictions to [a, c] and [c, b] (road-restrict: the restriction of a road is a road). The CONCATENATION form of the notes (gamma || rho, two roads glued at a point) is not stated: it needs the glued road, which is primitive-glue (batch 22) applied to each coordinate. Existence of the integral for a road and a continuous f is line-int-exists (batch 23). EARLIER NOTE: Not in the library. The DEFINITIONS exist since 2026-09-21, for functions ON [a, b] (structure-library/path-integral.scm): is-path, is-road(gamma, dgamma, a, b) with the derivative dgamma an explicit argument, trace, cc-int (the notes' equation (44)) and line-int(f, gamma, dgamma, a, b). Proven since: the integral pw-int is well defined (two piecewise primitives have the same endpoint difference), linear, additive over adjacent intervals and monotone; cc-int is linear over CC and additive; the notes' estimate (45) (cc-int-abs-bound); the trace of a path is compact (path-trace-compact); line-int of 1 along a road is gamma(b) - gamma(a); the opposite road and Dieudonne (9.6.1). Existence of a primitive of a piecewise continuous function (Dieudonne 8.7.2) is NOT proven, so the primitives of an integrand's coordinates are hypotheses wherever a value of an integral is asserted. Juxtaposition of two roads (Dieudonne 9.6.2) is not defined yet.
%
\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.2}
\begin{prop}[{Fundamental theorem for line integrals}]\label{thm:line-int-of-derivative}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{line-int-of-derivative}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{df}, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\mathit{df} \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{hbz} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, \mathit{hbz}, \operatorname{df}(\mathit{hbz})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}, a, b) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{df}, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \\ \quad \quad =\; (f(\operatorname{pgam}(b)) - f(\operatorname{pgam}(a))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-chain}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{dm}, g, x, u, f, l, d. \\ \quad (\mathit{dm} \subseteq \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (g \in (\mathit{dm} \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \mathit{dm}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, g, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \forall \mathit{msy} \in \mathit{dm}.\; (g(\mathit{msy}) \in u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, g(x), l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (d \in \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}((\lambda \mathit{pat} \in \mathit{dm}.\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(g(\mathit{pat}))), x, \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}((\lambda \mathit{pat} \in \mathit{dm}.\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(g(\mathit{pat}))), x, \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}((\lambda \mathit{pat} \in \mathit{dm}.\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(f(g(\mathit{pat})))), x, \operatorname{real\text{-}part}((l \cdot d))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}((\lambda \mathit{pat} \in \mathit{dm}.\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(f(g(\mathit{pat})))), x, \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((l \cdot d))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proof uses the following tactics and lemmas.
%

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} Proven 2026-09-23 (line-int-of-derivative): f holomorphic on the open set U, df in fun(U, CC) its derivative (is-diff-on at every point of U), gamma a road ON [a, b] with derivative dgamma and trace inside U; then line-int(df, gamma, dgamma, a, b) = f(gamma(b)) - f(gamma(a)). The derivative is a PARAMETER df rather than the notes' f', because line-int takes a function as integrand. No primitive of the integrand is assumed: f o gamma is the primitive (holomorphic-chain, the chain rule of a holomorphic f with a road, coordinatewise). Roads are the tree's is-road with a finite exceptional set (restatement over Dieudonne's regulated primitives pending the user's decision).
%
\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.3}
\begin{cor}[{Polynomials integrate to zero over a closed path}]\label{thm:line-int-closed-road-of-derivative}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{line-int-closed-road-of-derivative}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{df}, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\mathit{df} \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{hbz} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, \mathit{hbz}, \operatorname{df}(\mathit{hbz})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}, a, b) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{pgam}(b) = \operatorname{pgam}(a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{df}, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) = 0) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{affine-closed-road-integral}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{gbp}, \mathit{gbq}, \mathit{gbw} \in \mathbb{C}, \mathit{gbg} \in (\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall \mathit{gbz} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{gbg}(\mathit{gbz}) \simeq (\mathit{gbp} + (\mathit{gbq} \cdot (\mathit{gbz} - \mathit{gbw})))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pgam}(b) = \operatorname{pgam}(a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{gbg}, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) = 0) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{affine-has-primitive-cc}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{gbp}, \mathit{gbq}, \mathit{gbw} \in \mathbb{C}, \mathit{gbf} \in (\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall \mathit{gbz} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{gbf}(\mathit{gbz}) \simeq ((\mathit{gbp} \cdot \mathit{gbz}) + ((\mathit{gbq} \cdot ((\mathit{gbz} - \mathit{gbw}) \cdot (\mathit{gbz} - \mathit{gbw}))) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(2)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, \mathit{gbf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{gbz} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \mathbb{C}, \mathit{gbf}, \mathit{gbz}, (\mathit{gbp} + (\mathit{gbq} \cdot (\mathit{gbz} - \mathit{gbw})))) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} UPDATED 2026-09-25 (batch 29-B): PROVEN in the form the tree can state: for a closed road (gamma(b) = gamma(a)) the integral of the derivative of any holomorphic f is 0 (line-int-closed-road-of-derivative), and the affine function p + q(z - w) integrates to 0 around a closed road (affine-closed-road-integral, through its primitive affine-has-primitive-cc). The notes' 'polynomial function' has no object in the tree (no complex polynomial function), so the general polynomial case is not stated; the affine case is what Goursat uses. Not in the library. The DEFINITIONS exist since 2026-09-21, for functions ON [a, b] (structure-library/path-integral.scm): is-path, is-road(gamma, dgamma, a, b) with the derivative dgamma an explicit argument, trace, cc-int (the notes' equation (44)) and line-int(f, gamma, dgamma, a, b). Proven since: the integral pw-int is well defined (two piecewise primitives have the same endpoint difference), linear, additive over adjacent intervals and monotone; cc-int is linear over CC and additive; the notes' estimate (45) (cc-int-abs-bound); the trace of a path is compact (path-trace-compact); line-int of 1 along a road is gamma(b) - gamma(a); the opposite road and Dieudonne (9.6.1). Existence of a primitive of a piecewise continuous function (Dieudonne 8.7.2) is NOT proven, so the primitives of an integrand's coordinates are hypotheses wherever a value of an integral is asserted.
%
\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.4}
\begin{lem}[{Splitting a segment integral at an interior point}]\label{thm:segment-int-split}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{segment-int-split}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{pz}_{0}, \mathit{pzw} \in \mathbb{C}, \mathit{lrpt} \in \operatorname{ooint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}((\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{pz}_{0} + (\mathit{psx} \cdot \mathit{pzw}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 0, 1) \\ \quad \quad \quad \subseteq\; u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{pz}_{0} + (\mathit{psx} \cdot \mathit{pzw}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; \mathit{pzw}), 0, 1) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (\mathit{pz}_{0} + (\mathit{psx} \cdot (\mathit{lrpt} \cdot \mathit{pzw})))), (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (\mathit{lrpt} \cdot \mathit{pzw})), 0, 1) + \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; ((\mathit{pz}_{0} + (\mathit{lrpt} \cdot \mathit{pzw})) + (\mathit{psx} \cdot ((1 - \mathit{lrpt}) \cdot \mathit{pzw})))), (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; ((1 - \mathit{lrpt}) \cdot \mathit{pzw})), 0, 1)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{segment-int-abs-bound}}

\vnbpart{\texttt{segment-int-reverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{pz}_{0}, \mathit{pzw} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}((\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{pz}_{0} + (\mathit{psx} \cdot \mathit{pzw}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 0, 1) \\ \quad \quad \quad \subseteq\; u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\mathit{pz}_{0} + \mathit{pzw}) + (\mathit{psx} \cdot (-1 \cdot \mathit{pzw})))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (-1 \cdot \mathit{pzw})), 0, 1) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; (-1 \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (\mathit{pz}_{0} + (\mathit{psx} \cdot \mathit{pzw}))), (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; \mathit{pzw}), 0, 1)) \end{array}}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}, a, b) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{lrpc}, \mathit{lrpd}, \mathit{lrpl}, \mathit{lrpm} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 < \mathit{lrpl}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\mathit{lrpm} + (\mathit{lrpl} \cdot \mathit{lrpc})) = a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\mathit{lrpm} + (\mathit{lrpl} \cdot \mathit{lrpd})) = b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{lrpc} < \mathit{lrpd}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{lrpr}, \mathit{lrpk} \in (\operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{lrpc}, \mathit{lrpd}) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{lrpz} \in \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{lrpc}, \mathit{lrpd}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{lrpr}(\mathit{lrpz}) \simeq \operatorname{pgam}((\mathit{lrpm} + (\mathit{lrpl} \cdot \mathit{lrpz})))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{lrpz} \in \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{lrpc}, \mathit{lrpd}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{lrpk}(\mathit{lrpz}) \simeq (\mathit{lrpl} \cdot \operatorname{dgam}((\mathit{lrpm} + (\mathit{lrpl} \cdot \mathit{lrpz}))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{lrpr}, \mathit{lrpk}, \mathit{lrpc}, \mathit{lrpd}) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{line-int-adjacent}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}, a, b) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{licv} \in \operatorname{ooint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(\mathit{pgam}, \operatorname{ccint}(a, \mathit{licv})), \operatorname{restrict}(\mathit{dgam}, \operatorname{ccint}(a, \mathit{licv})), a, \mathit{licv}) + \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(\mathit{pgam}, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{licv}, b)), \operatorname{restrict}(\mathit{dgam}, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{licv}, b)), \mathit{licv}, b)) \end{array}}

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} UPDATED 2026-09-25 (batch 29-A): PROVEN for the segment itself (theorem-library/line-int-reparam.scm): segment-int-split splits the integral along the segment z0 + s w, s in [0,1], at the interior point z0 + t w (0 $<$ t $<$ 1) into the integrals along the two sub-segments, through the affine reparametrisation of the line integral, the notes' (48) (line-int-affine-reparam). The endpoint cases and the restatement with the segment functoid SEG-INT are batch 30. UPDATED 2026-09-23 (batch 24): proven for ANY road, line-int-adjacent (split at an interior point c of [a, b]); the segment of the notes is the special case where gamma is a straight segment (segment-is-road), and the restriction of a segment is not restated as a segment. EARLIER NOTE: Not in the library. The DEFINITIONS exist since 2026-09-21, for functions ON [a, b] (structure-library/path-integral.scm): is-path, is-road(gamma, dgamma, a, b) with the derivative dgamma an explicit argument, trace, cc-int (the notes' equation (44)) and line-int(f, gamma, dgamma, a, b). Proven since: the integral pw-int is well defined (two piecewise primitives have the same endpoint difference), linear, additive over adjacent intervals and monotone; cc-int is linear over CC and additive; the notes' estimate (45) (cc-int-abs-bound); the trace of a path is compact (path-trace-compact); line-int of 1 along a road is gamma(b) - gamma(a); the opposite road and Dieudonne (9.6.1). Existence of a primitive of a piecewise continuous function (Dieudonne 8.7.2) is NOT proven, so the primitives of an integrand's coordinates are hypotheses wherever a value of an integral is asserted.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.5}
\begin{lem}[{The barycentric-subdivision sum}]\label{thm:tri-int-subdivision}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{tri-int-subdivision}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}, \mathit{gouc} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(\mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}, \mathit{gouc}) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}, \mathit{gouc}) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; (((\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goua}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(\mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(\mathit{goua}, \mathit{gouc})) + \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(\mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}), \mathit{goub}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(\mathit{goub}, \mathit{gouc}))) + \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(\mathit{goua}, \mathit{gouc}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(\mathit{goub}, \mathit{gouc}), \mathit{gouc})) + \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(\mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(\mathit{goub}, \mathit{gouc}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(\mathit{goua}, \mathit{gouc}))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{seg-int-split-at}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(\mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}), 0, 1) \\ \quad \quad \quad \subseteq\; u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{gouc} \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(\mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}), 0, 1). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goua}, \mathit{gouc}) + \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{gouc}, \mathit{goub})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{segment-int-reverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{pz}_{0}, \mathit{pzw} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}((\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{pz}_{0} + (\mathit{psx} \cdot \mathit{pzw}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 0, 1) \\ \quad \quad \quad \subseteq\; u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\mathit{pz}_{0} + \mathit{pzw}) + (\mathit{psx} \cdot (-1 \cdot \mathit{pzw})))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (-1 \cdot \mathit{pzw})), 0, 1) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; (-1 \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (\mathit{pz}_{0} + (\mathit{psx} \cdot \mathit{pzw}))), (\lambda \mathit{psx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; \mathit{pzw}), 0, 1)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} PROVEN 2026-09-25 (batch 30, theorem-library/goursat.scm). The triangle integral TRI-INT(f, a, b, c) is DEFINED as the sum of the three segment integrals (the user's decision, docs/goursat-definitions-2026-09-25.md), so the triangular path is not a road object; the subdivision S(triangle) is written out as the four vertex triples with CC-MID. Hypothesis: f continuous on a set containing CONV3(a, b, c).
%
\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.6}
\begin{prop}[{Cauchy's theorem for triangles (Goursat)}]\label{thm:goursat-triangle-except}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{goursat-triangle-except}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{goxx}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad (\mathit{goxx} \in u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{goxx})), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{goxx})))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(\mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) = 0) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{goursat-vertex}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{goxx}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad (\mathit{goxx} \in u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{goxx})), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{goxx})))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(\mathit{goxx}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goxx}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) = 0) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{tri-int-fan}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(\mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxx} \in \operatorname{conv3}(\mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; ((\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxx}) + \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}, \mathit{goxx})) + \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goxc}, \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxx})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{tri-int-vertex-split}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(\mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxt} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; ((\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goxa}, (\mathit{goxa} + (\mathit{goxt} \cdot (\mathit{goxb} - \mathit{goxa}))), (\mathit{goxa} + (\mathit{goxt} \cdot (\mathit{goxc} - \mathit{goxa})))) + \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, (\mathit{goxa} + (\mathit{goxt} \cdot (\mathit{goxb} - \mathit{goxa}))), \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc})) + \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, (\mathit{goxa} + (\mathit{goxt} \cdot (\mathit{goxb} - \mathit{goxa}))), \mathit{goxc}, (\mathit{goxa} + (\mathit{goxt} \cdot (\mathit{goxc} - \mathit{goxa}))))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{conv3-avoids-vertex}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((\mathit{goxb} - \mathit{goxa}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((\mathit{goxc} - \mathit{goxa})))) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 < \mathit{goxt}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{goxt} \leq 1) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (\mathit{goxa} \in \operatorname{conv3}((\mathit{goxa} + (\mathit{goxt} \cdot (\mathit{goxb} - \mathit{goxa}))), \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (\mathit{goxa} \in \operatorname{conv3}((\mathit{goxa} + (\mathit{goxt} \cdot (\mathit{goxb} - \mathit{goxa}))), \mathit{goxc}, (\mathit{goxa} + (\mathit{goxt} \cdot (\mathit{goxc} - \mathit{goxa}))))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{collinear-cases}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((\mathit{goxb} - \mathit{goxa}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((\mathit{goxc} - \mathit{goxa})))) \\ \quad =\; 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \mathit{goxc} \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(\mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}), 0, 1) \vee \\ \quad \quad \mathit{goxa} \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(\mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}), 0, 1) \vee \\ \quad \quad \mathit{goxb} \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(\mathit{goxc}, \mathit{goxa}), 0, 1) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{tri-int-collinear}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(\mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{goxc} \\ \quad \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(\mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}), 0, 1) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{goxa} \\ \quad \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(\mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}), 0, 1) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{goxb} \\ \quad \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(\mathit{goxc}, \mathit{goxa}), 0, 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) = 0) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{tri-int-restrict}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxw}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{goxw} \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(\mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) \subseteq \mathit{goxw}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(\operatorname{restrict}(f, \mathit{goxw}), \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxb}, \mathit{goxc}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{goursat-triangle}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}, \mathit{gouc} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(\mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}, \mathit{gouc}) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{goua}, \mathit{goub}, \mathit{gouc}) = 0) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} PROVEN 2026-09-26 (batch 35) WITH THE EXCEPTIONAL POINT: the exceptional-point hypothesis is the notes' (f continuous on the open set u, x in u, f holomorphic on u minus \{x\}), spelled with restrict(f, difference(u, singleton(x))) because HOLOMORPHIC-ON types its function on exactly its set. Proof: x off the hull, Goursat on u minus \{x\}; x in the hull, the fan through x and the vertex case three times; the vertex case is Rudin 10.13 (shrink the triangle towards the vertex; the two remaining triangles avoid x by affine independence; the collinear triangle through the three placements). Earlier: PROVEN 2026-09-25 (batch 30) for f HOLOMORPHIC ON ALL OF U: holomorphic-on(U, f), a, b, c in U, CONV3(a, b, c) subset U implies TRI-INT(f, a, b, c) = 0 (goursat-triangle). The notes' hypothesis 'continuous on U and holomorphic on U minus a point x' is the strengthening of a later batch, needed by the Cauchy integral formula. The proof departs from the notes at the common point of the nested triangles: no Cantor intersection and no compactness; the chosen sub-triangles are driven on the standard triangle and the vertex sequence telescopes (cc-telescoping-limit-bound), its limit lying in CONV3 by definition. No diameter and no length are defined: the estimates are per segment with the perimeter as a term.
%
\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.7}
\begin{cor}[{Segment integrals in a convex set}]\label{thm:cauchy-convex-segments-except}
%

\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-segments-except}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.8}
\begin{prop}[{A primitive on a convex set}]\label{thm:cauchy-convex-primitive-except}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-primitive-except}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{goxx}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex}(u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad (\mathit{goxx} \in u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{goxx})), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{goxx})))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxo} \in u. \exists \mathit{goxg} \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, \mathit{goxg}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxz} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, \mathit{goxg}, \mathit{goxz}, f(\mathit{goxz})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-diff-on-of-eps-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{goxs}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \mathit{goxs}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxg} \in (\mathit{goxs} \to \mathbb{C}), \mathit{goxa} \in \mathit{goxs}, \mathit{goxl} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxe}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{goxe}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{goxd}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{goxd}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxy} \in \mathit{goxs}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{goxy} - \mathit{goxa})) < \mathit{goxd}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(((\operatorname{goxg}(\mathit{goxy}) - \operatorname{goxg}(\mathit{goxa})) - ((\mathit{goxy} - \mathit{goxa}) \cdot \mathit{goxl}))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; (\mathit{goxe} \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{goxy} - \mathit{goxa}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \mathit{goxs}, \mathit{goxg}, \mathit{goxa}, \mathit{goxl}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-continuous-at-add-const}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall f, \mathit{goxg} \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), \mathit{goxk} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{goxz} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{goxg}(\mathit{goxz}) \simeq (f(\mathit{goxz}) + \mathit{goxk})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \mathit{goxg}, \mathit{rgy}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-primitive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex}(u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{gouo} \in u. \exists \mathit{goug} \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, \mathit{goug}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{gouz} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, \mathit{goug}, \mathit{gouz}, f(\mathit{gouz})) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.9}
\begin{cor}[{Cauchy's theorem on a convex set}]\label{thm:cauchy-convex-closed-except}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-closed-except}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{goxx}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex}(u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad (f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, \mathit{rgy}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad (\mathit{goxx} \in u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{goxx})), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{goxx})))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}, a, b) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pgam}(b) = \operatorname{pgam}(a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) = 0) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex}(u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}, a, b) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pgam}(b) = \operatorname{pgam}(a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) = 0) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{line-int-closed-road-of-derivative}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, \mathit{df}, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\mathit{df} \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \forall \mathit{hbz} \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, \mathit{hbz}, \operatorname{df}(\mathit{hbz})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\mathit{pgam}, a, b) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{pgam}(b) = \operatorname{pgam}(a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{df}, \mathit{pgam}, \mathit{dgam}, a, b) = 0) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
